proposed_widenings.name: soul_transfer
proposed_widenings.justification: Clone's core effect is that the original creature's soul migrates into the waiting clone body, restoring the creature there with full personality, memories, and abilities. No v4 effect atom captures this — it is distinct from heal (restores HP), create_companion (summons a separate creature), transport_exile (moves a creature spatially), and return_on_end (lifecycle reset). This is a body-replacement resurrection: the soul leaves the corpse and takes up residence in a pre-built vessel.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the creature's soul transfers to the clone if the soul is free and willing to return. The clone is physically identical to the original and has the same personality, memories, and abilities

proposed_widenings.name: CastingTime.hours
proposed_widenings.justification: Clone has a casting time of 1 hour. The current CastingTime surface type only has action, bonus_action, reaction, and minutes variants. An hours variant (or extending minutes to accept hour-scale amounts with a unit field) is needed.

proposed_widenings.name: AnchorTarget.vessel
proposed_widenings.justification: Clone plants its trigger on a sealable vessel containing the clone body. AnchorTarget only supports location (door_or_window) and area (cube). A vessel anchor — a physical container that houses an inert creature body — is a new structural concept.
proposed_widenings.evidence: An inert duplicate of that creature forms inside the vessel used in the spell's casting

proposed_widenings.name: AnchoredEvent.creature_dies
proposed_widenings.justification: The trigger that releases Clone's effect is the death of a specific creature (the original). Existing AnchoredEvent variants (physical_contact, enters_area) cover creature interaction with a place, not the death of a specific named creature.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the original creature dies after the clone finishes forming

proposed_widenings.name: AnchoredFilter.soul_willing_and_free
proposed_widenings.justification: The soul transfer fires only if the soul is both free (not trapped) and willing to return. This is a conditional gate on the release. Existing AnchoredFilter only has creature_exemption_list (chosen at cast). The soul-state predicate is mechanically distinct — it cannot be represented as an exemption list chosen at cast time.
proposed_widenings.evidence: if the soul is free and willing to return

notes: Clone most closely maps to the anchored_trigger family — it plants something that waits until a trigger event fires (original's death). However, the blocking gap is the soul_transfer effect atom: no v4 atom captures 'original creature's soul migrates to a pre-built body, restoring the creature there.' Secondary surface gaps: CastingTime lacks an hours variant; AnchorTarget lacks a vessel variant; AnchoredEvent lacks creature_dies; AnchoredFilter lacks a soul-state predicate. The 120-day gestation period (clone grows before it is ready) is also unmodeled in the anchored_trigger family, though this may be representable as a timed duration on the store phase rather than a new atom. Do not force into activation or ongoing_effect — neither fits the deferred trigger-on-death shape.
